Masala Lassi (Butter Milk)
By: Amritha Kalyani
Published: Tuesday, August 31, 2010 - 3:34pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup Yogurt-
1 cup Water- and ¼
2 dashs Hing-
3 pinchs Jeera Powder-
Cilantro- Handfull
Salt- to taste
1 Green Chili (Jus for flavor)-

Preparation

1 Blend all the ingredients in a blender until everything is ground and mixed well 2 Pour it in a glass and serve. Believe me its delicious and very good drink for summer. 3 You can garnish with cilantro adn a dash of jeera powder. Hope you enjoyed it! Good day!
